name: ChatGPT-Community
description: Docker packaging for the upstream ChatGPT Community app. Standard: just the app, with persistent appdata. Optional: map selected folders or enable GPU acceleration. Advanced: optional SSH access for server administration; follow the setup steps under Additional Requirements below. WebUI login is optional; keep access on a trusted LAN/VPN.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Keep the existing path to preserve login, pairing and SSH keys

paths.name: Optional: shared folder
paths.description: Leave blank for app-only mode. Select one folder to make it available at /workspace/files (read-only by default). Change Access Mode to Read/Write only if the app may edit/delete files.

variables.name: WebUI username (optional)
variables.description: Only used when a WebUI password is set; unrelated to your ChatGPT account

variables.name: WebUI password (optional)
variables.description: Leave blank for no WebUI login (trusted LAN/VPN only). Set a strong unique password to enable login.

variables.name: Wayland
variables.description: Use Wayland/labwc; false selects the single-app X11 fallback

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Container user ID; retain the existing value on upgrade

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Container group ID; retain the existing value on upgrade

variables.name: Advanced: provision host SSH
variables.description: Optional. See Additional Requirements above for setup. true creates missing keys/config only; authorize the public key separately. false does not revoke existing access.

variables.name: Advanced: SSH host
variables.description: For new SSH setup only: enter the reachable server LAN IP/hostname, not localhost. Existing SSH config is preserved. Not needed for normal app use.

variables.name: Advanced: SSH user
variables.description: Account on the target server; only used for a new SSH config. Root grants full host control once authorized; choose a restricted account where supported.

variables.name: Advanced: SSH port
variables.description: Target SSH port; only used for a new SSH config.
